name: tsumi
description: Requires pstack. 223mle's agent-development approach as skills: fix agent failures in order - tools, JSON schemas, and templates first; automated checks and regression evals second; prompt rules only for judgment that cannot be encoded; human review only for suspicious output. Includes tsumi-mode (router over pstack's poteto-mode), agent-design-review, and unslop (writing and rewriting Japanese documents, in place of pstack's technical-writing and unslop).
